answer: Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A juniper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the falcon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
